name: Logo cloud
description: A grid, a row or an endless strip of client or partner logos, each optionally linked, under an optional heading ("Trusted by").

layout.description: grid: logos in columns. row: one line that wraps. marquee: an endless CSS-only strip that stands still for reduced motion.

columns.description: Logos per row on wide screens (grid layout); two on phones, three on tablets.

logoHeight.description: Height of every logo (the width follows): small, medium or large.

style.description: plain: logos in their own colours. grayscale: muted grey, full colour on hover or focus. mono-light: drawn white, for a dark band.

align.description: Alignment of the heading and of the logos in a row.

heading.label: Heading
heading.description: Line above the logos (Trusted by, Our partners).

items.label: Logos

imageAlt.label: Name
imageAlt.description: The company's name, read in place of the logo.

href.label: Link
href.description: The company's site, when the logo links there.

items.description: The logos, in order (a Gutenberg gallery or columns of logos, Elementor image carousel/gallery of logos, Divi images).

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

a11y: A list of logos; each logo's text is the company's name, and a linked logo is one link named by it. The section is labelled by its heading.

pattern.summary: row of small logos, often linked
